headline: US envoy Steve Witkoff plans to fly to Moscow to meet Putin with peace ideas developed with Ukraine and European partners
dek: Witkoff to fly to Russia to meet Putin with Ukraine/Europe-developed peace ideas; Zelensky says US intel-sharing working again, Starshield restore possible within ~48h.
sources: US official (anonymous, via Axios); Zelensky (post-Oslo remarks); Mezha
fault_line: Is Witkoff carrying Kyiv's plan to Moscow — or Trump's?

sections.what_happened: Witkoff to fly to Russia to meet Putin with Ukraine/Europe-developed peace ideas; Zelensky says US intel-sharing working again, Starshield restore possible within ~48h.
sections.what_verified: Oslo meeting confirmed across outlets (0500-05); Axios relay via tracker + Mezha consistent on Moscow trip; Zelensky intel remarks consistent with 0500-05 (US resumed early-warning sharing).
sections.what_disputed: Venue discrepancy: Mezha says 'Miami' meeting with Ukrainian/European officials — Oslo is the verified one; treat Miami reference as unverified garble. Peace ideas' content undisclosed.
sections.why_matters: The envoy shuttle: Witkoff takes the Ukraine-Europe plan to Putin — the first real test of whether the big-three table has anything behind it.
sections.context: Background: Ukraine diplomacy — NEW: US envoy Steve Witkoff plans to fly to Moscow to meet Putin with peace ideas developed with Ukraine and European partners (US official to Axios); follows Oct 20 Oslo talks (Zelensky, Witkoff, Norway PM Støre, Finland President Stubb; Kushner ill, remote); Zelensky: US intelligence-sharing 'working again', Starshield connectivity could be restored within ~48 hours; Mezha: Witkoff + Kushner may travel to Moscow after meeting Ukrainian/European officials

totw_analysis: Our read: The envoy shuttle: Witkoff takes the Ukraine-Europe plan to Putin — the first real test of whether the big-three table has anything behind it. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is Witkoff carrying Kyiv's plan to Moscow — or Trump's?
